objects.name: Analytic 1723
objects.description: For Android, detect Lockscreen Bypass by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate Application Permission via Android Enterprise DPC / Application Vetting [DevicePolicyManager.getPermissionGrantState(); PackageManager manifest/requested-permission review]; Application State via Android Enterprise / EMM [Managed package inventory/status and package metadata]; Protected Configuration via Android Enterprise DPC [DevicePolicyManager policy/compliance/security-state queries and SecurityLog events where supported]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: MDM-managed authentication policy changes only. Any lock policy weakening outside MDM-authorized change is anomalous. Derive from MDM policy management logs.
Approved accessibility and Device Admin apps that may interact with lockscreen for legitimate purposes (enterprise kiosk). Derive from MDM catalog.
Default 10s between lock state and anomalous app activity. Lock-bypass is near-instantaneous.
